description: Version of the deterministic BAdW source identity graph contract.
Stable identifier for one BAdW source witness occurrence; it never asserts a canonical dictionary entry identity.
Stable identifier from the BAdW HTML article or generated-PDF-span source inventory.
BAdW delivery form, for example database_article or generated_pdf_span.
Source-preserved lemma, homonym and Tibetan-heading identity fields; Latin is historical Library of Congress transliteration, not Wylie.
Cached-source/page/span provenance needed to locate the exact BAdW witness.
confident_link, candidate_only, or unmatched; candidate evidence is never silently promoted to identity.
Provisional WtSOCR local-entry anchor only for a confident identity link; it is not a final canonical dictionary-entry ID.
Best local candidate and matching evidence retained for candidate_only or confident_link dispositions.
Stable provisional local-anchor identifier based on the WtSOCR volume and exact QA headword coordinate (volume:page:line); legacy entry IDs remain provenance only.
provisional_local_anchor: an interim coordinate anchor awaiting systematic source-side canonicalization.
All BAdW witness IDs with a high-confidence edge to the provisional local anchor.
